messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Meera Joshi
Mumbai | meera.joshi@example.com

Professional Summary
Engineering lead with nine years in full-stack development and four years managing teams.

Experience
Engineering Manager, Nykaa (2021 - Present)
Managed a team of 8 engineers across checkout and loyalty; hired 5 of them.
Ran quarterly planning with product and design and cut the release cycle from monthly to weekly.
Coached two engineers into senior roles and introduced a career ladder for the team.

Tech Lead, MakeMyTrip (2017 - 2021)
Led the rewrite of hotel search from a PHP monolith to Node.js services.
Designed the caching strategy with Redis and Elasticsearch that halved search latency.

Software Engineer, Capgemini (2015 - 2017)
Built Angular dashboards for an insurance client.

Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, React, Angular, Elasticsearch, Redis, MySQL, AWS, system design, hiring, mentoring, stakeholder management

Education
B.E. Information Technology, University of Mumbai, 2015

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
